evd_title: 39.18% of 3063 annotated biomedical citation instances contained accuracy errors
finding: 39.18% of 3063 annotated biomedical citation instances contained accuracy errors
P: 3063 citation instances to 100 highly cited PMC-OA biomedical reference articles (Sarol corpus)
O: Error prevalence: 39.18% errors (n=1200); major 18.02%, minor 21.16%; accurate 60.82%
S: Descriptive corpus-annotation study (cross-sectional); 5 life-science student annotators
